title: Visitor completes a standard vote
description: Installation is in NORMAL state with healthy network; visitor votes on a light theme and sees confirmation.
userSteps: Submit a vote and wait for confirmation
expectedOutcomes: Status and action areas are both visible
Confirmation or toast visible after vote

title: Manual refresh and retry on a laggy network
description: Network latency is high. Visitor performs manual refresh, sees loading indicator, then retries a failed message submission.
userSteps: Send a wall message which may fail once
Retry the failed action until success
expectedOutcomes: Retry button or link available after failure
Message list updates optimistically once success is reported

title: Installation paused
description: Installation is PAUSED, so user actions must be disabled with clear explanation.
expectedOutcomes: Helper text explaining maintenance or pause
Tab labels still operable for information access

title: Crowded queue warning
description: Installation is CROWDED; queue warnings are shown but some actions remain.

title: No programs upcoming
description: No programs available; UI must show empty-state guidance.

title: Keyboard navigation and contrast
description: User navigates with keyboard only and expects focus outlines and aria labels.
userSteps: Navigate to message box via Tab
Submit a message with Enter key
